findings.finding: Dog vocabulary was not actually taught; all affected inputs now use prior hors with neuter ðæt.

Anterior simple preterite and active habban readings need a stated context. Example02 and A02 supply the completed house before the visit; A03/A04 explicitly say the speaker performed completed building work.
Wæs gewiten is recognition-only intransitive perfect/result; wæs sittende does not impose an English progressive. No independent composition of these recognition-only patterns is assigned.

Reported sīe/wǣre are subjunctives; hæfde in the anterior report is homographic with the indicative, so the key must state mood from the assigned report context. Wolde expresses intended later action without asserting fulfillment.
All eight source-question quotations match the selected exact passage. S06 requests an English passive only. S04 asks contextual actors rather than a unique case for ambiguous hīe.
